projects.title: AI-Powered Scientific Research Assistant
projects.eyebrow: Product Case Study — AI & Platform Infrastructure
projects.context: Researchers and scientists spent weeks manually parsing thousands of unstructured scientific publications, laboratory notebooks, and dense biochemical datasets. Finding, extracting, and cross-referencing information was slow, highly siloed, and prone to human error.

technicalHurdles.title: Hallucination Risks
technicalHurdles.description: In scientific and clinical environments, unsupported LLM responses can invalidate research and lead to costly laboratory workflow errors.

technicalHurdles.title: Lack of Provenance
technicalHurdles.description: Standard generative AI systems do not inherently track the precise source or original coordinates of extracted facts.

technicalHurdles.title: Data Silos
technicalHurdles.description: Scientific content arrived in fragmented formats, including PDFs, proprietary instrument files, and genomic sequences that traditional pipelines could not process consistently.

projects.strategy: Led the discovery phase through interviews with lead scientists to identify critical friction points. Rather than building a generic wrapper around a single AI model, shaped a multi-tenant orchestration platform that converts unstructured documents into provenance-aware, structured scientific assets.

tradeoffs.title: Multi-LLM Strategy vs. Single Model Vendor
tradeoffs.description: Designed a dynamic workflow using GPT, Claude, and Gemini because different models offered distinct strengths in semantic reasoning, large-table processing, cost efficiency, and performance.

tradeoffs.title: Proactive Constraints vs. Passive Filtering
tradeoffs.description: Prioritized structured templates and validated schemas over unrestricted free-form prompts so generated outputs could conform to scientific data requirements.

pillars.title: Dynamic RAG Pipeline
pillars.description: Shaped an enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline covering document ingestion, intelligent text chunking, semantic metadata tagging, and specialized knowledge-graph indexing.

pillars.title: Multi-Model Orchestration and Structured Outputs
pillars.description: Designed an extraction layer that converts raw scientific text into structured JSON and Pydantic-compatible schemas, supported by programmatic validation against predefined scientific ontologies.

pillars.title: Traceable Citation Provenance
pillars.description: Established metadata tracking so generated insights could be linked to their source document, page number, and bounding-box coordinates for rapid scientist verification.

pillars.title: Human-in-the-Loop Validation
pillars.description: Implemented review workflows requiring credentialed scientists to validate AI-generated conclusions before they entered downstream laboratory processes.

operatingModel.title: Spec-Driven Development
operatingModel.description: Introduced a Markdown-based specification framework that clarified end-to-end user journeys and exposed API and platform dependencies earlier in delivery.

operatingModel.title: Pod and Squad Governance
operatingModel.description: Led four cross-functional delivery teams comprising approximately 25 data scientists, machine-learning engineers, product specialists, and UX professionals.

outcomes.title: Research Velocity
outcomes.description: Reduced scientific data extraction and synthesis workflows from weeks to hours, helping research teams evaluate and adjust discovery strategies more quickly.

outcomes.title: Trust and Auditability
outcomes.description: Improved governance through provenance-aware processing, structured validation, traceable citations, and human approval controls.

outcomes.title: Platform Reusability
outcomes.description: Designed reusable extraction services with structured REST API contracts so additional digital chemistry products could consume the platform capabilities.

projects.title: AI-Powered Scientific Research Assistant
projects.problem: Researchers spent weeks manually analyzing large scientific datasets and publications.
projects.approach: Shaped an end-to-end GenAI platform using RAG and GPT, Claude, and Gemini workflows, with structured outputs and human-in-the-loop validation aligned to enterprise data governance.
projects.impact: Reduced research analysis from months to weeks, accelerating scientific discovery and user adoption.

projects.title: Software Download & Licensing Platform
projects.problem: Fragmented third-party tools and redundant software licenses created high operating costs across divisions.
projects.approach: Owned the product lifecycle from discovery through scaling for a centralized platform covering software distribution, entitlements, subscriptions, and licensing.
projects.impact: Identified approximately $2M in cost savings, validated $650K in immediate savings with $1.5M projected, and supported approximately 10% month-over-month active-user growth.

projects.title: Analytical Data Store & Semantic Knowledge Graph
projects.problem: Fragmented proteomics data across instruments and labs limited interoperability, cross-study insights, and research decisions.
projects.approach: Led solution shaping and dependency management for a Kubernetes-based microservices platform spanning FAIR data standardization, ingestion pipelines, ontology validation, semantic integration, and LLM/RAG querying.
projects.impact: Enabled AI-driven data discovery and cross-lab interoperability, accelerating proteomics research insights for scientists.
